Question Text: Tell me about yourself and your professional background.
Purpose: Understand candidate background and communication style.
Suggested Follow-up: Which part of your experience is most relevant to this role?

Question Text: Why are you interested in this role?
Suggested Follow-up: What specifically attracted you to this position?

Question Text: What do you understand about the responsibilities of this role?
Purpose: Check whether candidate understands the job.
Suggested Follow-up: Which responsibility do you think is most important and why?

Question Text: Describe a project or task you worked on that is relevant to this role.
Suggested Follow-up: What was your exact contribution?

Question Text: Tell me about a difficult problem you solved at work or during a project.
Suggested Follow-up: What alternatives did you consider?

Question Text: What are the most important skills required to succeed in this role?
Suggested Follow-up: Which of these skills is your strongest?

Question Text: What tools, platforms, or software have you used that are relevant to this role?
Suggested Follow-up: Can you give an example of how you used one of them?

Question Text: Explain a complex topic from your field to someone without technical knowledge.
Suggested Follow-up: How would you adjust your explanation for senior management?

Question Text: Describe a time you worked with a team to complete a task or project.
Suggested Follow-up: What challenges did the team face?

Question Text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a colleague or stakeholder. How did you handle it?
Suggested Follow-up: What would you do differently next time?

Question Text: How do you prioritize tasks when you have multiple deadlines?
Suggested Follow-up: Can you give an example?

Question Text: Tell me about a time you had to learn something new quickly.
Suggested Follow-up: How did you measure your progress?

Question Text: Describe a mistake you made and what you learned from it.
Suggested Follow-up: How did you prevent it from happening again?

Question Text: Describe a time you had to make a decision with limited information.
Suggested Follow-up: What risks did you consider?

Question Text: How do you make sure your work is accurate and high quality?
Suggested Follow-up: Can you give an example where quality control mattered?

Question Text: Tell me about a time you had to communicate with stakeholders or clients.
Suggested Follow-up: How did you handle different expectations?

Question Text: Describe a time you worked under pressure.
Suggested Follow-up: What helped you stay focused?

Question Text: Give an example of a time you improved a process or suggested a better way to do something.
Suggested Follow-up: What was the impact of your suggestion?

Question Text: What would you do if you noticed an error, risk, or issue that others ignored?
Suggested Follow-up: Who would you inform and why?

Question Text: Why do you think you are a good fit for this role?
Suggested Follow-up: What is one area you still need to improve?
